rows.meaning: person who lives on an island
rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person who lives on an island.

example.english: I know an islander who lives on one of the outlying islands.
example.traditional: 我識得一個住喺離島嘅島民。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik1 dak1 jat1 go3 zyu6 hai2 lei4 dou2 ge3 dou2 man4
